cases.note: \Delta followed by a subscripted symbol is one symbol named Delta_<symbol>.
cases.sympy_gives: error: UnexpectedCharacters: No terminal matches '\' in the current parser context, at line 1 col 1 \Delta v_{x} ^

cases.note: Leibniz notation is refused by default; never read as (d*y)/(d*x) = y/x.
cases.sympy_gives: (derivative, x)

cases.sympy_gives: error: UnexpectedCharacters: No terminal matches 'y' in the current parser context, at line 1 col 12 \frac{d^{2}y}{dx^{2}} ^

cases.note: d alone is an ordinary variable (distance over time); only d/d<var> is a derivative.
